method.sentence_and_gold: Read all 1400 texts, grouped into 350 a/b scenarios. Inspect status, actions, required/forbidden/unmentioned, constraints and clarification. Read both paraphrases for each role; verify the complete role gold is identical.
method.contrast_gradient: Each a/b group must change required capabilities, forbidden capabilities, or intent_status. Constraint-only differences do not count as a training contrast.
method.ontology: Judge against the complete existing 32-capability ontology. Focus-eight is not the out-of-scope boundary. A restricted commercial route does not make a known supported semantic intent out_of_scope.
method.scope: Distinguish explicit whole-capability prohibitions from target/modality/time limits. Unmentioned is not forbidden. Silence in final output is not itself prohibition of microphone capture. Existing app data is separated from new device access.
method.isolation: Inspect scenario meaning and ordinary phone context, not only IDs or text deduplication. Compare actual old train/validation IDs from the recorded 705/180 manifest. Use character n-gram nearest-neighbor candidates as leads, not as proof of semantic equivalence.
method.reference_scope: All 1663 reference texts participate in normalized exact checks; semantic comparison uses all 240 old expansion family summaries, previously read original 300/reference163 texts, and inspected relevant scenario/text pairs. This is not an exhaustive proof across every possible pair.
method.review_standard: Shared ontology, common phone vocabulary or the same label alone is not leakage. Independent ordinary situations and genuine differences in action, resource, state or scope are allowed. Confirmed same-scenario paraphrases and entity/field-only template substitutions are revised or isolated.
method.revision_procedure: Send specific findings directly to each author; reread all actually revised groups. After semantic approval, compare all four files row by row against audited snapshots; allow review.cross_review metadata only.
method.reserved_confidentiality: Reserved prompts and per-row gold were communicated only between its author and independent reviewer. Root received IDs, issue types, counts and hashes. This report contains no reserved prompt or per-row gold. No model predictions or metrics were used in this review.
method.checks: Independent stdlib checks plus character n-gram comparison aids in /tmp. No model inference, training, app build, permission execution or phone testing was performed by the reviewer.

findings.resolution: Exclude the entire old validation family from model selection; keep old source immutable for legacy regression.

reserved_finding_visibility: ID/type/status only; concrete reserved content excluded

legacy_exclusions.policy: Remove the full old validation family from current model selection; preserve its immutable original source for legacy regression. Do not modify old data files.

candidate_limitations: All examples are agent-generated and AI-reviewed; human review remains pending. They are not collected real-user requests or a human-verified production benchmark.

These are known ontology classes; common positive controls and phone-action primitives are expected. Scenario grouping and this review do not establish unseen-intent generalization or mathematical absence of all semantic similarity.
Reserved data lives in the shared workspace. Blindness is an operational protocol, not an access-control guarantee; public release would end future test secrecy.
Scope, sequence and clarification text are annotations; the current training objective does not learn a full slot/sequence executor or free-text clarification generation.
Platform authorization, commercial HarmonyOS interface availability, runtime compatibility and NPU numerical/performance acceptance require separate verification.
Old 295 observed internal test candidates remain legacy regression, not a fresh held-out benchmark. Do not use reserved results for another model-selection round.
